Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.weather

Class OpenMeteo

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.weather.OpenMeteo
public final class OpenMeteo extends Object
The AWT-free weather backend of the Weather app: it talks to the free Open-Meteo forecast API (no API key, no third-party library) exactly like the desktop's Weather widget does, using only the JDK's HttpClient and a small dependency-free JSON reader.

This is the seam the Swing WeatherPanel renders: all fetching, parsing, WMO weather-code description and unit conversion live here, so the logic is exercised headlessly by OpenMeteoTest with no network and no X display. Data is always requested in Celsius / km-h and converted for display, so toggling °C/°F never re-fetches.

    • search

      public static List<OpenMeteo.City> search(String query) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Searches the Open-Meteo geocoding API for locations matching query. Returns up to SEARCH_COUNT candidates.
      Parameters:
      query - a city name or partial name (e.g., "Paris", "San Fran")
      Returns:
      a list of matching cities, never null (empty on error/no results)
      Throws:
      IOException - on transport or non-2xx HTTP error
      InterruptedException - if the calling thread is interrupted

    • saveCities

      public static void saveCities(List<OpenMeteo.City> cities, Path path) throws IOException
      Saves a list of cities to a JSON file. Each city is serialized as {"name": "...", "country": "...", "lat": ..., "lon": ...}.
      Parameters:
      cities - the cities to save
      path - the file path to write to
      Throws:
      IOException - on write error

    • loadCities

      public static List<OpenMeteo.City> loadCities(Path path) throws IOException
      Loads cities from a JSON file. The format matches saveCities(java.util.List<org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.weather.OpenMeteo.City>, java.nio.file.Path).
      Parameters:
      path - the file path to read from
      Returns:
      a list of cities, never null (empty on error/missing file)
      Throws:
      IOException - on read error
